IF page shows 'Flight Unavailable' illustration AND result count shows '(0) Flights' AND all form fields are correctly filled → ETRAV_ZERO_INVENTORY (etrav-side); do not classify as EQIS failure.

IF Etrav results page shows 'Showing (N) Flights' header AND flight cards are rendered AND no progress bar is visible → mark as SUCCESS regardless of prior timeout log; do NOT classify as ETRAV_TIMEOUT (eqis-side false negative).

IF call-log shows 'page.goto: Timeout Nms exceeded' AND frames show a fully rendered Etrav page with no error illustration → EQIS_GOTO_TIMEOUT (eqis-side); the automation's navigation wait timed out, not an Etrav platform failure.

IF 'Where From?' field contains only a partial string AND autosuggest shows only generic Popular Cities (not the target IATA code) AND Playwright throws elementHandle.type timeout → EQIS_TYPE_TIMEOUT_ON_ORIGIN_FIELD (eqis-side): automation failed to complete typing into the input element before the 30 s timeout.

IF results page shows 'Showing (N) Flights' headline AND flight cards are visible AND no loading bar is present → mark as SUCCESS, not FAILURE; do not rely solely on progress-bar absence timing to gate result detection.

IF result page shows 'Showing (N) Flights' text AND flight cards are rendered AND no loading bar is visible, yet automation reports 'loading bar did not disappear / no result evidence detected' → FALSE_NEGATIVE_RESULT_DETECTION (eqis-side): result-presence selector missed the loaded state.

IF final frames show a populated Etrav results page (flight count > 0, fare cards visible, no progress bar) AND failure reason cites 'loading progress bar did not disappear' → EQIS_RESULT_DETECTION_MISS (eqis-side): automation timed out waiting for a stale/already-gone progress bar or used a wrong DOM selector to confirm results loaded.

IF results page shows 'Showing (N) Flights' header AND Book Now buttons are visible AND no loading bar is present → mark as SUCCESS; the result-detection selector is broken, not Etrav. (EQIS_RESULT_DETECTOR_MISS)

IF results page shows 'Showing (N) Flights' AND flight cards are visible AND form fields are correctly populated → mark as SUCCESS regardless of whether progress-bar disappearance was explicitly observed within the timeout window (EQIS_FALSE_NEGATIVE_PROGRESS_BAR_TIMEOUT).

IF results page shows 'Showing (0) Flights' AND 'Flight Unavailable' illustration AND message 'no longer available / fully booked / removed from our system' AND all form fields are correctly filled → ETRAV_ZERO_INVENTORY (etrav-side); do not count as EQIS automation failure.

IF Return? field shows '–' AND departure is correctly filled AND form is otherwise healthy (no Etrav error page) AND status is AUTOMATION_DATE_INCOMPLETE → RETURN_DATE_COMMIT_FAILURE (eqis-side); automation's date-picker interaction did not successfully select/confirm the return date.

IF hotel destination field contains typed text AND no autosuggest dropdown appeared AND Check-In/Check-Out remain blank AND page stays on hotel home → AUTOSUGGEST_DOWN (etrav-side).
IF search status=SUCCESS AND results count > 0 AND page shows hotel cards → do NOT rate as CRITICAL; result-validator must check HTTP status and result count before escalating rating.

IF destination is filled AND both date fields remain '–' after two pickHotelDateRange attempts AND page is otherwise healthy → HOTEL_DATE_PICKER_INTERACTION_FAILURE (eqis-side): automation failed to trigger or commit the calendar date selection.

IF results page shows 'Showing (0) Flights' AND 'Flight Unavailable' illustration AND message about flight being fully booked/removed AND all form fields are correctly populated → ETRAV_ZERO_INVENTORY (etrav-side); do not count as EQIS automation failure.

IF hotel search form shows 'Check-out date is required' validation error AND Check-Out field displays '–' AND page did not navigate to results → EQIS_CHECKOUT_DATE_NOT_SET (eqis-side): automation failed to interact with or confirm the check-out date picker.

IF results page shows 'Showing (N) Flights' header AND flight cards are visible AND no loading spinner is present → mark as SUCCESS regardless of prior timeout flag; do NOT report ETRAV_TIMEOUT if final screenshot contains result evidence.

IF results page shows flight count heading AND fare cards are visible BUT automation reports 'loading bar still present / no result evidence' → EQIS_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RESULT_DETECTION: automation's success-check selector timed out before (or missed) the loaded state, not an Etrav issue.

IF hotel search form stays on landing page AND Check-Out field shows '-' AND red error 'Check-out date is required' is visible → EQIS_HOTEL_CHECKOUT_NOT_SET (eqis-side): automation skipped or mis-targeted the checkout date picker.

IF final frames show a fully rendered flight results list with flight count AND fare cards present BUT the run was marked FAILED due to 'loading bar timeout' → classify as EQIS_RESULT_DETECTION_FALSE_NEGATIVE (eqis-side); the results selector or progress-bar-gone check is too strict or targeting the wrong DOM element.

IF hotel search form shows 'Check-out date is required' validation error AND page remains on /hotels → EQIS_CHECKOUT_DATE_NOT_SET (eqis-side): automation typed/clicked check-in but did not successfully select a check-out date from the calendar.

IF result page shows 'Showing (N) Flights' header AND flight cards are visible AND no loading bar is present BUT failure is reported as 'loading bar did not disappear' → EQIS_RESULT_DETECTION_FALSE_NEGATIVE (eqis-side): result-presence check failed to match loaded DOM state.

IF hotel search form shows 'Check-out date is required' validation AND Check-Out field displays '–' AND destination/check-in are populated → EQIS_CHECKOUT_DATE_NOT_SET (eqis-side): automation failed to interact with the check-out date picker.
IF hotel destination autosuggest dropdown returns zero results AND status is AUTOSUGGEST_DOWN AND all captured frames are blank/white → ETRAV_HOTEL_AUTOSUGGEST_DOWN (etrav-side).

IF hotel search page renders normally AND destination is filled AND both date fields remain '–' after two automation attempts AND no calendar/datepicker overlay is visible → HOTEL_DATE_PICKER_INTERACTION_FAILURE (eqis-side); automation failed to open or interact with the date picker widget.

IF results page shows 'Showing (0) Flights' AND Etrav renders its 'Flight Unavailable' illustration with 'fully booked or removed from our system' message AND all form fields are correctly populated → ETRAV_ZERO_INVENTORY (etrav-side); do not classify as automation failure.

IF hotel search form destination is filled AND both date fields remain '–' AND no calendar overlay is visible across all frames AND status is AUTOMATION_DATE_INCOMPLETE → HOTEL_DATE_PICKER_OPEN_FAILURE (eqis-side): automation failed to open/interact with the Etrav hotel date picker widget.

IF hotel form shows destination filled AND check-in filled AND check-out is '-'/empty AND 'Check-out date is required' validation visible → EQIS_CHECKOUT_DATE_NOT_SET (eqis-side): automation failed to write checkout date into the date picker.

IF Return? field shows '–' AND trip-type radio still shows 'One Way' AND departure date is filled AND no Etrav error page present → EQIS_RETURN_DATE_NOT_COMMITTED: automation failed to switch to Round Trip and/or interact with the return date calendar (eqis-side).
IF search status=SUCCESS AND results count > 0 AND no error page visible AND rating=CRITICAL with no failure reason → FALSE_POSITIVE_CRITICAL_RATING (eqis-side rating logic bug).

IF search status=SUCCESS AND results page shows ≥1 flight AND no error page present BUT rating=CRITICAL with no failure reason → EQIS_FALSE_CRITICAL_RATING (eqis-side); check result-validator scoring logic.

IF results page shows 'Showing (N) Flights' AND flight cards are rendered AND no progress bar is visible, treat as SUCCESS regardless of prior loading-bar timeout flag — do NOT mark as FAILURE. (EQIS_FALSE_POSITIVE_RESULT_DETECTION)

IF hotel search form shows 'Check-out date is required' validation error AND Check-Out field contains '–' AND page remains on /hotels → EQIS_CHECKOUT_DATE_NOT_SET (eqis-side): automation failed to interact with or confirm the checkout date picker.

IF final frames show a fully rendered results page with flight cards AND result count header present AND no loading bar visible → mark as EQIS_RESULT_DETECTION_FALSE_NEGATIVE (eqis-side); the scraper/detector timed out before recognising the loaded state.
